arStrings.szText: {icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Storm{/c} Skills no longer cost Spirit to cast. Casting a {c_important}Storm{/c} Skill consumes all available Spirit to increase {c_important}Storm{/c} Skill damage by {c_number}[Affix_Value_1*100|1||x%|]{/c} per Spirit consumed for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"*100|x%|]{/c}. Additional bonuses may stack but do not refresh.
